visual_brief.subject: GitHub Copilot moves into Xcode's native assistant
verified_context: GitHub Copilot is available in public preview inside Xcode 27.3 beta's built-in coding assistant.
GitHub's separate Xcode extension remains available.
The announcement does not establish feature parity, policy equivalence or production readiness.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Two client paths can reach the same development work without being operationally equivalent.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: Two parallel physical tool paths approach one stone workpiece, with a terracotta route through a native cradle and a separate charcoal extension rail.

candidate_notes.A: Selected: a broad terracotta route passes through a compact dark native cradle while a separate charcoal rail approaches the same stone workpiece. The two paths stay distinct in all crops.
candidate_notes.B: The dual tool rails and active work surface are story-specific, but the drill, rubble and curved tracks create unnecessary operational detail at small sizes.
candidate_notes.C: Two tool heads approach one workpiece, but the native-versus-extension distinction is less explicit and the separated machines dilute the shared-path idea.

crop_review.article_desktop: The 21:9 center crop retains both routes, the native cradle and the shared workpiece.
crop_review.article_mobile: The terracotta and charcoal approaches remain distinct in 16:9.
crop_review.square: The center square keeps the cradle and workpiece central while showing enough of each route to establish two paths.
crop_review.thumbnail: At 320px wide, the warm native path and separate dark rail remain easy to distinguish.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared all candidates above the declared references for tactile tool-study composition, restrained pale-stone/terracotta/charcoal materials and concise integration metaphors. A best matches the references and communicates two operationally distinct client paths without interface imitation.

generation_metadata.visual_review: Codex model self-review of three full-size candidates, two declared golden references, a reference-first comparison sheet, and desktop/mobile/square/thumbnail crops. The canonical Playwright renderer could not launch because Chromium was unavailable, so ImageMagick produced the equivalent inspected sheet; repository validation remains authoritative.

A.prompt: Wide tactile tool study: a terracotta route through a compact dark native cradle and a separate charcoal extension rail approach one shared pale-stone workpiece; no logos, text or interface elements.

B.prompt: Wide mechanical workshop with two distinct curved tool rails, one terracotta and one charcoal, converging on the same pale-stone workpiece; restrained editorial materiality and no prohibited elements.

C.prompt: Wide minimal tool-artifact study with a terracotta native tool emerging from a stone cradle and a separate charcoal extension tool approaching one shared stone workpiece; no prohibited elements.
